seo.title: Pricing — Day Pass, Pro and Lifetime | SolPrompter
seo.description: SolPrompter early adopter pricing: a $3.99 one-day pass, Pro at $6.99 per month or $49 a year, and a $169 lifetime plan. AI Scroll, cloud sync and remote control included.
seo.ogTitle: SolPrompter Pricing — Lock In Your Price Forever
seo.ogDescription: Early adopter pricing: One-Day Pass $3.99, Pro $6.99/month, Lifetime $169. Prices go up as we add more premium features.

pricingSchema.productDescription: Online AI teleprompter with voice-following scroll, notch mode, remote control and 4K recording.

hero.title: Lock In Your Price Forever
hero.description: Prices will increase as we add more premium features. Whatever you pay today is the price you keep.

items.q: What are the AI Scroll rate limits?
items.a: AI Scroll limits are sized for normal individual creator usage. To ensure reliable service for everyone, extremely excessive, automated or abusive usage may be limited under our Fair Use Policy.

Yes. These are early adopter prices and they will increase as we add more premium features. While your subscription stays active without interruption, you keep the price you signed up at; a Lifetime purchase is a one-time payment that is never affected by later price changes.

items.q: What does the Lifetime plan actually cover?
items.a: A single payment for the Pro features, plus every update and premium feature we release for SolPrompter, with no renewal. Lifetime refers to the lifetime of the product, not the lifetime of the purchaser — it lasts for as long as SolPrompter is commercially operated by us. The full terms are in the Billing and Refund Policy.

Yes. Cancel at any time from your account billing settings, or email contact.solprompter@gmail.com. Automatic renewal stops immediately and you keep paid access until the end of the billing period you already paid for.

We offer a voluntary 7-day refund guarantee on your first purchase made directly through SolPrompter, subject to the conditions in the Billing and Refund Policy. Mandatory consumer rights in your country always apply on top of it.

items.q: What happens when the One-Day Pass expires?
items.a: Pro features simply stop after 24 hours and the pass does not renew. Your scripts and recordings stay where they are, and you can buy another pass or move to Pro whenever you want.
Unless stated otherwise, displayed prices exclude taxes that must be collected separately. The final amount, currency and any applicable VAT or sales tax are shown before you confirm the payment.
